title: Trump reportedly called into Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Huang’s return
lede: Semafor reports that President Trump dialed into an Nvidia board meeting to push for Jensen Huang's return, and Nvidia announced the reinstatement shortly after.

points: Trump told CNBC he spoke to the board and convinced them.
Huang, CEO for 33 years, had stepped down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two Nvidia employees, one a direct report.
Nvidia's release says the board took input from senior US government officials and is confident his return poses no national security risk.
Huang still faces closed-door sessions with three House committees on December 1 and a public Senate Banking Committee appearance.
The New York Times reported that Marco Rubio briefed Trump about Alice Huang in May, though Trump denies being told.

sections.text: Nvidia's board rested its decision on assurances from the government, tying the leadership of the main AI chipmaker to the White House while export-control questions stay open.
